Subject: Quarter velocity check-in + stage cleanup

Team —

We are 7 weeks into Q2 and the finance team flagged Acme as a top coverage risk for the quarter. I pulled a quick snapshot (attached) and we have a ~40% shortfall versus the committed run rate if nothing moves.

As a focused sweep, I need the following by EOD Tuesday:
- Updated commit status for all opportunities in the ACME territory (use the attached commit_template.csv)
- Stage hygiene: mark any stalled deals as "Nurture" or move to a specific next-step (no more vague "Engaged")
- Identification of any short-cycle expansion motions we can accelerate this quarter

I know a few of you are already on Acme. Ben — can you drop updated close dates and confidence for the three open seats you own? Laura — please confirm renewal timing for the entitlement add-on. Grace — any procurement blocker updates?

Attachments: coverage_snapshot_Q2.xlsx (summary), commit_template.csv (simple CSV to paste into HubSpot)

I'll consolidate and run a 20-minute sync Wednesday 10am PT if we have the inputs. If we don't, I'll assume we need to do a more thorough remediation.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas / Ben —

Thanks for the heads-up, and apologies for the slow movement on our side. Quick status from procurement: the primary gating item is a short SOW clarification on data residency and SLAs. Procurement can sign off within two weeks if we get an updated SOW that explicitly has the EU+US residency language and the 99.9% token-generation SLA. I've attached a short outline of the SOW changes we need.

Timelines: procurement expects to complete internal approvals by 2028-04-26 if the SOW is in our hands by 2028-04-14.

Action items for Redwood:
- Please send an updated SOW draft with the residency clause and SLA by EOD 2028-04-14
- Confirm whether the pricing in the proposal can be held through April 30 (we need that window)

Elena Morris
Head of Platform Partnerships | AcmeCorp
emorris@acmecorp.com

Elena — thanks, that's exactly the clarity we needed.

Ben — can you prioritize the SOW language with legal and draft the residency/SLA bullets and send me a redline by tomorrow morning? Laura, confirm whether we can hold pricing until 2028-04-30 (finance gate). Grace, if procurement needs any additional compliance artifacts (SOC2 attestation, retention policy excerpt), please add them to the shared folder and flag me.

I'll run the 20-minute sync tomorrow 10am PT to confirm final commitments and update finance. If we get the SOW to them by EOD 4/14, we can keep this in the commit plan for April. Otherwise, we reclassify to "Nurture" and remove from commit for Q2.
